nodes.title: Use-case sample packs on Import: seven synthetic contact lists, one per starter agent. Each goes through the real preview, verdicts and receipt. 'Add me as a test contact' puts the member's own verified phone in the list and marks it contact.test_member_id when saved.
nodes.details: Packs: insurance renewal, loan EMI reminder, COD confirmation, admissions follow-up, clinic appointment reminder, rooftop solar lead qualification, AC service feedback. 12 rows each. Numbers 9000000000-9000000099 only, never shared between packs. Names and cities across regions, at least 4 languages per pack, and the per-contact facts the template's agent says (dates relative to the day loaded). Each pack has one duplicate (the number written another way), one or two opt-outs, and one missing consent. Tools source.sample.list (read) and source.sample.load (draft); migration 0109. Web: From a sample tab (lazy chunk). Tests: intake-samples 3/3 (every pack fills every fact its agent says; only a verified phone; only the caller's own; re-checked at save; a file can never set the mark); e2e flow and axe screen; screenshots at 1440 and 390.

nodes.title: A test contact is contact.test_member_id: the member whose own verified phone it is. Only the sample flow's 'Add me' sets it, for the caller's own verified_test_phone, re-checked when the upload is saved. No file, CRM or webhook column can set it. Telephony checks verified_test_phone again at dial time.
nodes.rationale: On staging a campaign must be able to ring the owner and nobody else. A flag that only the member's own verified phone can earn, and that the dial gate re-checks, cannot be forged from imported data.
nodes.reverse_if: Telephony prefers to key the staging allowlist on verified_test_phone alone; the flag then stays only for the UI and for keeping test contacts out of analytics.

nodes.title: Sample packs: 7 of 7 packs fill every per-contact fact of an agent made from their template (0 missing). Each has 1 duplicate in the file and at least 1 opt-out counted as not callable. The test contact is marked only for a verified phone of the caller (4 refusal paths held). e2e 82/82.
nodes.n: 7 packs x 12 rows; 4 refusal cases; e2e 82 flows
nodes.method: node:test on a fresh Postgres (intake-samples.test.ts, source.map with agentId per template); Playwright via e2e/run.sh
nodes.not_verified: A real staging call to the owner's phone: telephony is not live, and the allowlist rule is telephony's to build.

nodes.title: Will telephony's staging allowlist key on contact.test_member_id plus verified_test_phone at dial time (proposed to session_01EMpetZaBqaoTD8i89vtAx9), or on verified_test_phone alone?
nodes.closes_when: Telephony answers and the dial gate enforces the agreed rule with a test.
